name: Enterprise Use Case Tests
description: Real-world enterprise Agentforce use cases — tests action-aware instructions, anti-hallucination, action chaining, and multi-intent handling at production complexity

tests.prompt: Build a Case Intelligence Agent for JPMorgan Chase. This is an EMPLOYEE agent (not customer-facing) — it assists internal service agents working cases in Service Console. It has 3 topics: (1) Similar Case Search — uses a custom Apex action Search_Similar_Cases (apex://CaseIntelligence.searchSimilarCases with subject as text, description as text, product_category as text, account_type as text) that queries Data 360 vector indexes to find top 5 semantically similar resolved cases. Also has Summarize_Resolution (apex://CaseIntelligence.summarizeResolution with case_ids as text) to summarize patterns across matches, and Propose_Resolution (apex://CaseIntelligence.proposeResolution with case_id as text, pattern_summary as text) to generate step-by-step resolution. (2) Case Classification — uses Classify_Case (apex://CaseIntelligence.classifyCase with subject as text, description as text, account_tier as text) that returns reason, sentiment_score, suggested_priority, and routing_team. Also Route_To_Specialist (flow://Case_RouteToSpecialist with classification_json as text) to assign to correct queue based on priority rules. (3) Case Analytics — uses Daily_Case_Summary (apex://CaseIntelligence.dailySummary with priority_filter as text) for supervisor dashboards. The agent should always use the search action for finding similar cases — never fabricate resolution patterns from training data. Action results are the source of truth.

tests.prompt: Build a Customer Resolution Agent for Delta Air Lines that handles complaints across channels (social, email, phone, app). It has 3 topics: (1) Complaint Analysis — uses Extract_Complaint (apex://DeltaResolution.extractComplaint with case_description as text) to extract structured complaint attributes (complaint_type, flight_number, severity, emotional_tone, channel, financial_impact) from unstructured text. Also Assess_Churn_Risk (apex://DeltaResolution.assessChurnRisk with contact_id as text, complaint_json as text) that evaluates churn probability based on SkyMiles tier, lifetime value, complaint history, and social reach — outputs risk score 1-100 and retention tier. (2) Resolution Generation — uses Generate_Resolution (apex://DeltaResolution.generateOffer with complaint_json as text, churn_risk as text) that matches complaint to resolution playbook adjusted by churn tier (Flight Delay + Low Risk → 2500 SkyMiles; Flight Delay + High Risk Diamond → $200 voucher + lounge pass; Lost Baggage → $50/day interim). Guardrails: max compensation limits, manager approval for >$500. Also Draft_Response (apex://DeltaResolution.draftResponse with offer_json as text, channel as text, language as text) for channel-appropriate responses in 5 languages. (3) Social Media — uses Social_Triage (flow://Delta_SocialTriage with post_url as text) and Publish_Response (flow://Delta_PublishResponse with response_text as text, platform as text) with manager approval for public posts. The agent must use the extract action to analyze complaints — never guess complaint attributes. Multi-intent: customer may ask about both flight delay AND lost baggage in one message.

tests.prompt: Build a Billing Intelligence Agent for Comcast Xfinity that handles billing inquiries for 30M+ subscribers. It has 3 topics: (1) Billing Analysis — uses Billing_Anomaly_Detection (apex://BillingIntelligence.detectAnomalies with account_id as text) that compares current vs previous 3 invoices, identifies new charges, expired promotions, overages, and rate increases — outputs plain-English explanation. Also Data_Usage_Summary (apex://BillingIntelligence.getUsageSummary with account_id as text, date_range as text) for usage trends with daily/weekly/monthly aggregation vs plan limits, and Payment_History (apex://BillingIntelligence.getPaymentHistory with account_id as text) for 12-month payment health summary. (2) Competitive Retention — uses Competitive_Analysis (apex://BillingIntelligence.analyzeCompetitor with competitor_name as text, plan_details as text) to query Data 360 for side-by-side comparison with AT&T/Verizon/Spectrum. Also Generate_Retention_Offer (apex://BillingIntelligence.generateRetentionOffer with account_id as text, competitor_json as text) with guardrails (margin floor, manager approval for >30% discount), and Generate_Pitch (apex://BillingIntelligence.generatePitch with offer_json as text, customer_concerns as text) for personalized talking points. (3) Proactive Upsell — uses Service_Quality_Analysis (apex://BillingIntelligence.analyzeServiceQuality with account_id as text) for bandwidth utilization and overage detection, and Upsell_Recommendation (apex://BillingIntelligence.recommendUpsell with quality_json as text) that calculates savings from upgrade vs current overages. The agent MUST use billing actions to explain charges — never fabricate invoice details or pricing. Action outputs are the only source of truth for financial data.
